questions.question: The speaker holds a large object up to the camera partway through the video. Right after that object leaves the frame, what does the on-screen caption say first?
questions.answer: After the large sword is shown and leaves the frame, the caption reads 'thì cái lưu ý đấy là' (the point to note is...), after which the opening sentence about 'khi một khi mà các bạn đã làm to' is repeated.
accept: thì cái lưu ý đấy là
the lưu ý caption then the opening sentence is repeated
the point to note is, then he repeats the opening line

questions.question: In the closing dark TikTok screen at the very end, how does the search bar change over its first couple of seconds?
questions.answer: It first appears empty (with red and cyan offset bars behind it), then a white bar with a magnifier icon, and then the account name text '@tu.phu.ngo.trie...' appears inside it.
accept: starts empty then the username text appears
empty search bar, then @tu.phu.ngo.trie text appears in it
text gets typed or filled in after the bar appears

questions.question: Early in the video, the small TikTok logo with the account handle sits on one side of the frame. On which side is it at the very start, and where does it move to after about 5 seconds?
questions.answer: At the start it is on the left side (middle-left), and at about 5 s it jumps to the right side (lower right), where it stays.
accept: from the left side to the lower right

questions.question: How many times during the video does the speaker say the sentence about 'when you have become big, you will surely have to cooperate, right?' (the 'khi một khi mà các bạn đã làm to ... hợp tác, đúng không' line)?
questions.answer: Twice: once at the very start and once again near the end around 130 s.

questions.question: For about how long is the large silver-blue sword visible in front of the speaker?
questions.answer: About 3 seconds (roughly from 126 s to 129 s).

questions.question: For about how long does the closing dark TikTok logo screen stay on screen at the end of the video?
questions.answer: About 4 seconds (roughly from 160.5 s to the end near 164.5 s).

questions.question: What is on screen in front of the speaker when he asks the audience 'anh em có thấy đẹp không?' (do you think it looks nice)?
questions.answer: A large silver-blue sword with a red hilt, held up in front of him.
accept: a toy sword held up to the camera

questions.question: When the speaker says 'hôm nay mình tiếp tục cái series' (today I continue the series), what new object shows up in the lower left of the frame?
questions.answer: A yellow spiky-haired toy figure (Naruto-like) appears at the lower left, while he holds his hand to his forehead.
accept: a yellow toy figure at lower left
